question.prompt: The water level rises by 3 centimeters per hour and is initially 20 centimeters. According to a linear model, how many centimeters is the water level after 4 hours?

solutions.explanation: The same number is added each time, so use \(y=20+3t\). When \(t=4\), the value is 32.
solutions.title: Evaluate the linear water-level model
